name: Tago Health (formerly BentoLabs AI)
long_description:
Tago Health builds AI agents for the billing back office of US healthcare providers. The agents work denials and A/R as teammates for your billing team.

When a claim is denied or underpaid, Tago's agents find out why, fix what went wrong, and draft and submit the appeal. A voice agent calls the payer and keeps following up until payment posts.

Your team approves the judgment calls, and every action is logged against the claim. Tago learns from every fix, so the same denial doesn't trip you up twice.

What Tago works on: denied claims and appeals, underpaid claims, claims with no response, aged A/R, and payer calls and follow-up.

Tago works inside your practice management system, clearinghouse and payer portals. No new logins, no migration, and we handle the setup.

Built for billing and revenue cycle teams, in-house or outsourced: providers and practices, physician groups, MSOs and RCM companies.

Trust Center: trust.tagohealth.com
one_liner: AI agents for healthcare denials and accounts receivable

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: We’re building Tago Health to help healthcare teams spend less time chasing payments and more time moving claims forward. Our AI agents investigate denied, underpaid and unpaid claims, prepare appeals, and follow up with payers inside the systems billing teams already use. Each resolution helps the team understand what went wrong and prevent the same issue from happening again.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Revenue cycle teams spend time investigating denied and unpaid claims, correcting issues, preparing appeals and following up with payers. Too often, the knowledge gained from resolving one claim does not carry forward to the next. Tago Health builds agents to help teams move unpaid claims forward in their existing systems, with expert review of judgment calls and actions logged against each claim. The aim is to resolve today's backlog while surfacing recurring causes and reducing avoidable rework.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Kaushik was hire #2 at Emergent (YC S24), where he led full-stack engineering, built the initial infrastructure for long-running agents, and shipped the mobile-dev agent that converted ~50% better than any other. Previously Decathlon, Pazcare, and Synup.
